steps: replace image URIs preserving image/material/mesh indices
verify pinned FBX vertex float32 bijection and same-winding topology
append exact source UVSet0 using glTF (u,1-v) convention; preserve original geometry bytes

texture_source.extraction: FBX 6000 binary Objects/Video Content raw byte properties associated with exact Filename basenames

derivatives.lineage_limitation: The official historical FBX embeds the exact filenames and matching Side Panels/Main Solar Panels Video associations referenced by the later pinned model. The 2024 update removed that FBX and added the current FBX/GLB without embedded texture bytes or texture hashes; unchanged pixels across the update cannot be independently proved. These are recovered historical source textures, not invented or manufacturer-verified current imagery.

uv_restoration.conversion: (u, v) -> (u, 1-v); no clamping; original samplers unchanged

derivatives.lineage_limitation: Restores the texture-free solid backside material and exact published RGBA from the official historical NASA GLB/FBX. All 39 historical/current Draco geometry chunks are byte-identical; the current GLB assigns a texture to this sole no-UV material consumer. This reviewed derivative corrects that incompatible association; it is not a byte-identical copy of the latest NASA asset or a NASA-approved modification. Other current materials, images, textures and binary geometry are unchanged.

source_guidance.nasa: NASA source credit and educational/informational usage guidance; third-party/branding exceptions retained
source_guidance.noaa_goesr: Original NOAA/NASA GOES-R Program source attribution; no endorsement implied
source_guidance.spacetwin: Original prototype-generated representative shapes; manufacturer identity and exact dimensions are not asserted
